SECRET_CREDENTIAL_CONTEXT.positive: The candidate describes secrets, credentials, access tokens, API keys, passwords, or private connection material.
SECRET_CREDENTIAL_CONTEXT.negative: The candidate only discusses generic authentication concepts without exposing or requesting secret material.
SECRET_CREDENTIAL_CONTEXT.boundary: Confirm only when the candidate is about sensitive credential handling, disclosure, or transfer.

PERSONAL_DATA_CONTEXT.positive: The candidate describes person-level data such as private identifiers, contact information, or sensitive personal records.
PERSONAL_DATA_CONTEXT.negative: The candidate only discusses public examples, synthetic placeholders, or non-personal aggregate information.
PERSONAL_DATA_CONTEXT.boundary: Confirm only when the candidate involves person-level data in a risky handling context.

PROPRIETARY_CODE_CONTEXT.positive: The candidate describes internal or proprietary implementation details, private source code, or security-sensitive code paths.
PROPRIETARY_CODE_CONTEXT.negative: The candidate only discusses public APIs, open-source examples, or generic programming concepts.
PROPRIETARY_CODE_CONTEXT.boundary: Confirm only when the candidate points to private implementation or security-sensitive code context.
